_about: Working glossary, updated 2026-11-16 for two news texts. The live glossary belongs in the private data repository. terms = words the dictionary lacks or splits wrongly; senses = a first meaning to show before the dictionary's; readings = context rules for single characters with several readings.

前三季度.meaning: the first three quarters of the year (January to September)

新质生产力.meaning: "new quality productive forces": policy term for innovation-driven, high-tech productivity

生猪.meaning: live hogs; pigs raised for slaughter

存栏.meaning: livestock on hand; number of animals currently in stock

出栏.meaning: (of livestock) sent to slaughter or market; slaughter numbers

克雷斯.meaning: Kress (surname); here Colette Kress, Nvidia's chief financial officer

贝森特.meaning: Bessent (surname); here Scott Bessent, US Treasury Secretary

李强.meaning: Li Qiang, Premier of China's State Council

业内人士.meaning: industry insiders; people in the trade

中东部.meaning: the central and eastern parts (of a country); not the Middle East

人次.meaning: person-times; number of visits or attendances (measure)

新闻联播.meaning: Xinwen Lianbo, the main evening news programme of China Central Television

秋招.meaning: autumn recruitment season for new graduates (short for 秋季招聘)

陆相.meaning: (geology) continental, formed on land or in lakes, as opposed to marine

防寒保暖.meaning: to protect against the cold and keep warm

停飞令.meaning: grounding order; order to suspend flights

纪录.meaning: record (best result or highest level reached)

一类新药.meaning: Class 1 new drug: an innovative drug not marketed before in China or abroad

元宇宙.meaning: Meta (the US company, in Chinese media usage); literally: metaverse

医保.meaning: medical insurance (short for 医疗保险)

senses.动能: (economics) momentum; growth driver, as in 新动能 "new growth drivers"
senses.于: (formal) at; on; in (a time or place), as in 于11月17日 "on 17 November"
senses.届: measure word for sessions, meetings and graduating classes, as in 第九届 "the ninth (edition)"
senses.次: time; occasion (measure word), as in 这次 "this time"
senses.家: measure word for companies, shops, hospitals and families, as in 这家公司 "this company"
senses.兼: and concurrently; holding two posts at once, as in 副总裁兼首席财务官
senses.起: (after 自 or 从 and a time) starting from, as in 自2013年起 "since 2013"
senses.致: to send to; addressed to, as in 致员工的信 "a letter to staff"
senses.项: measure word for items, tasks, projects and investigations, as in 这项调查
senses.被: by (marks the passive), as in 被纳入 "be included"
senses.种: kind; type (measure word), as in 107种药品 "107 kinds of drugs"
senses.展: exhibition; show (short for 展览), as in 国家展 "country exhibition"
senses.创: to set (a record or new high), as in 创历史新高; to create

readings.note: In 以…为… (take … as …) the reading is wéi, not wèi.
In 任命…为… (appoint … as …) the reading is wéi, not wèi.
